common.title: Cinder Shift 64
menu.context: The isolation protocol has sealed the geothermal complex. Equip Mira, restore the evacuation line and reach the airlock.
menu.noSave: No saved shift. Start with one research point.
menu.preview: One playable mission · three rooms. This is the end of the available preview.
menu.replaceText: The current shift, research and rewards will be replaced. Language and control settings stay.
menu.restartText: Room positions are not saved. Continue starts a fresh attempt with the same entry loadout and event plan, full integrity and zero score.
research.title: Suit workshop
research.context: Inspect a module, then confirm the purchase. You may keep your point and deploy with the base suit.
research.W1.name: Splitter
research.W1.effect: Fire three projectiles in a fan. Catch several targets with one shot.
research.M1.name: Ground impulse
research.M1.effect: A short ground dash. Recharges in 3 s; walls stop the suit.
research.D1.name: Reinforced frame
research.D1.effect: Suit integrity 6 → 8. Each attempt starts at full HP.
research.confirmText: Purchase {node} for 1 point? It applies to the next mission entry.
mission.name: Airlock
mission.goal: Restore the emergency line and leave
mission.route: A — suit check. B — service corridor. C — power cabinet and evacuation airlock. Robots may be bypassed.
mission.retryRule: After death, retry restores the entry loadout and the same event plan.
mission.conditionClosed: E02 · Upper maintenance route closed in B. The ground passage remains open to every suit.
mission.optionalCache: E03 · An optional repair cache is available at the safe entrance to B.
mission.objective.power: Restore the emergency line in room C
mission.objective.corridor: Cross the corridor. Cover blocks fire; the upper shelf changes firing height.
mission.objective.closed: Upper route locked. Cross below the shutter; cover still blocks fire.
mission.objective.hold: Hold {action} for {seconds} s to restore power
events.title: E03 / Repair cache
events.context: A service cache before the patrol zone. Choose one reward for this attempt, or leave it for later.
events.full: Integrity is full — no repair needed
events.once: One claim per attempt. No research points are awarded.
results.noReward: Airlock already rewarded. This replay grants no research points.
results.deathReward: No research points for a failed attempt. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
results.previewEnd: You reached the end of this preview. Research and loadout tests remain available; there is no next sector yet.
settings.title: Suit settings
settings.autofireHint: Auto-fire uses the same weapon effect and only targets visible enemies in front of the suit.
settings.controls.keyboard: A/D or arrows: move · Space: jump · S/↓: crouch · J/X: fire · E: interact · K/C: impulse when equipped · Esc: pause
settings.controls.touch: Left: movement and crouch. Right: jump, fire and interaction. Impulse appears only when equipped.
settings.controls.gamepad: Stick/D-pad: move · A: jump/confirm · RT: fire · X: interact · B: impulse/back in menus · Menu: pause
settings.navigation: Menus: Tab or arrows to select · Enter/Space to confirm · Esc to go back. Gamepad: D-pad, A and B.
settings.telemetry: External game telemetry is disabled. Events stay in this tab.
pause.title: Pause
pause.manual: World and sound are paused. Resume explicitly when ready.
pause.blur: The window lost focus. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.hidden: The tab is in the background. World, timers and sound are paused.
pause.portrait: Rotate your phone to landscape. Then resume explicitly.
pause.save: Continue after a reload returns to the mission entrance with the same loadout and events.
training.note: TRAINING · no campaign progress or rewards
errors.title: Restart required
errors.load: Resources could not be loaded. Reload to try again.
errors.context: The browser lost the graphics context. Reload returns to the mission entrance if saving is available.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.save.unavailable: Storage is unavailable. This shift works in memory; closing or reloading may lose progress.
errors.save.write_failed: Saving failed. The current shift continues in memory; progress is not safely stored.
errors.save.corrupt: The saved shift is damaged. It has not been erased. Start a new shift only after confirming replacement.
errors.save.incompatible: This save uses an unsupported version. It has not been erased. Reset the shift explicitly to play this version.
errors.save.unknown_nodes: The save contains unknown research modules. Progress is kept; confirm replacement to start a new shift.
errors.resetText: This replaces only campaign progress. Language, sound and control settings stay.
accessibility.game: Game field. Controls are available in Settings.
accessibility.fps: Frame rate over the last minute
meta.description: Cinder Shift 64 — a playable emergency shift on Caldera 7. Nuts Games.
errors.save.replaceUnknown: Storage cannot be read right now. Starting a new shift may replace an earlier save when saving becomes available. Start a new shift?
character.title: Choose an operator
character.mira.name: Mira Wei
character.portrait: Mira in the equipped engineering suit
character.context: Mira is ready for the emergency shift. Other operators will become available later.
workshop.nextEntry: Modules apply on the next mission entry. Viewing modules does not spend research points.
workshop.spreadNote: Three projectiles: straight and at ±10°. Spread does not guarantee three hits. Projectile damage and fire rate stay the same.
workshop.dash: Ground dash: up to {distance} px in {seconds} s; cooldown {cooldown} s. No extra invulnerability.
workshop.salvage: Optional salvage score: {score}. It is separate from research points; bypassing robots is allowed.
workshop.deathHint.drone: Change height or take cover before the drone fires. Retry restores full integrity with the same loadout and conditions.
workshop.deathHint.walker: Use cover or crouch under the walker fire. Retry keeps the entry loadout and event plan.
workshop.deathHint.unknown: Watch the warning and use cover. Retry keeps the entry loadout and restores full integrity.
audio.title: Audio mixer
audio.unavailable: Some sounds are unavailable. The shift remains playable.
